sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-front man with short dark hair, dark brows and grey-black moustache, clean chin. Khaki folded side cap with small red star; olive high-collared tunic with two gold throat buttons and red-edged gold shoulder boards. Stern closed mouth, pale grey-beige full painted backing and soft light; preserve moustache only, cap and broad short closed collar.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-front man with short brushed dark hair greying at sides, furrowed brows, no clearly resolved dense moustache or beard; fine facial shading is ambiguous and must not become new facial hair. Dark olive high-neck tunic with large red collar tabs bearing three gold stars each, small gold button. Restrained closed mouth, pale grey-beige full backing; short broad collar transition.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven man looking slightly up toward screen left, thick swept dark hair and heavy brows. Very dark navy high-collared uniform with elaborate gold leaf collar, gold shoulder boards and buttons, two gold star decorations at viewer left and white/gold star at throat. Full pale grey-beige painted backing; preserve dark original version, stern mouth/tilt and broad short neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Clean-shaven near-front man with swept dark hair greying at temples, heavy brows and closed stern mouth. Black-navy lapelled uniform with gold leaf lapel embroidery, gold shoulder boards, white shirt/black tie and small red/gold decoration at viewer right. Full pale grey-beige backing and original subdued light; preserve dark uniform variant and compact broad shirt fit.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-front man slightly toward screen left with short neatly side-parted dark hair, fine brows and clean-shaven face. Black-navy lapelled uniform with gold leaf trim and gold shoulder details over pale grey pointed shirt/dark tie. Restrained closed mouth and full pale grey-beige painted backing; preserve dark variant and short broad collar fit.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Shadowed human bust with round glasses whose lenses glow bright red, grey-brown upper-head hair silhouette partly obscured by saturated effects, tightly set mouth with visible pale teeth. Black lapelled suit/white pointed shirt/dark tie. Intense red-orange lightning and red lens bloom overlay head, shoulders and full painted background with faint markings. Preserve existing lighting, overlays, silhouette and pose directly; fine hair/head details are unresolved under effects, so invent no extra headwear. Green mascot eyes may sit beneath the original red lens glow; short broad neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Bearded man slightly toward screen left with dark hair mostly covered by white draped headcloth secured with thick black/gold bands and linked gold fittings. Dark brows, short dark moustache and shaped chin/jaw beard, serious closed mouth. Olive military jacket/gold shoulder stars over light blue pointed shirt/navy tie. Full pale grey-beige backing; preserve headcloth folds/bands and short broad fitted neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older man turned toward screen right with white brows/short white moustache and full neat white beard, gentle closed mouth. White headcloth with black/gold horizontal bands and linked gold fittings, long cloth tail extending screen left with dark inner fold. Olive uniform/gold shoulder stars/light blue pointed shirt/navy tie; full pale grey-beige painted backing. Preserve headcloth, beard, expression and compact broad neck.
